assignments.essential_function: Track candidates through recruiting stages and summarize hiring funnel progress.

review: Compact native recruiting operations framework covering sourcing, screening, interviews, debrief, offer and acceptance, with stage velocity, conversion, source effectiveness, acceptance and time-to-fill metrics. Full 30-line source read. Useful as a light pipeline management skill rather than an ATS implementation, evidence rubric or advanced analytics engine. With ATS connected it can pull candidates and update statuses.
